answer: Each identity patrols a spiral route across a meadow, locking a 70-credit bond. Each epoch a raven draws a checkpoint; the patrol heartbeats in 10 minutes with a meadow reading, new serial. An auditor recomputes it from the public spiral-route table; late or reused serials burn the bond. First 38, k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 + 70,000 locked; honest 38 once, bond back. Rented-patrol rings fail: one body cannot cover two checkpoints.
